text:
pagerduty-bot: PAGER — High anomaly: rapid auth + embeddings traffic from ~320 unique IPs. signature: repeated /v1/embeddings with same key pattern. auto-escalate to on-call.

sam: saw it. traffic started ~10m ago. 5xxs are low but 429s spiking on edge.

kiran: where are the spikes geographically?

sam: mostly eu-west + one large cluster from ap-south-1. avg request size small, high QPS per IP.

ashley: quick mitigation plan: 1) tighten anonymous API key rate limit 2) apply WAF rule for header fingerprint 3) disable embeddings batch endpoints for anon keys 4) notify support for customer impact.

meera: +1. can we do captcha challenge on auth endpoints as a low-risk step?

opsbot: Running playbook: apply rate-limit profile "abuse-tight-2026" -> in progress.

sam: rate-limit profile applied to anon tier: 0.5 rps per-key, 50 rps per-IP. immediate drop in fanout seen.

ashley: WAF rule drafted and pushed to canary edge (eu-west). rule blocks requests with header `X-Client-Device: null` and user-agent pattern `^curl.*(bot|scrape)`

kiran: can you paste the rule?

ashley: ```
# waf rule snippet
if request.headers['x-client-device'] == 'null' and re.match(r'^curl.*(bot|scrape)', request.headers['user-agent']):
  block()
```

meera: captcha rollout deployed to login-v2 path in canary. latency impact negligible so far.

sam: embeddings batch endpoint disabled for anon keys. non-anon (paid) unaffected. routing shows 70% reduction in problematic requests.

support-ledger: heads-up — Support ticketing: two mid-sized customers reported 429s on embedding calls. flagging as P2. Sending template notice to affected customers with ETA.

meera: customer impact estimate: ~0.4% of total traffic, affecting ~4 customers with sustained failures.

kiran: I'm taking the pager for the next 45m. I'll keep the mitigations in place while we tune heuristics.

ashley: tuning plan: raise bot-score threshold from 0.6 -> 0.78 for auto-block, add transient scoring for repeated small-payload embeddings. Will roll change to canary then global if stable.

opsbot: Canary rollout of scoring change started (10% edges). monitoring: false positives = 0 so far.

sam: metrics: avg RPS from suspicious cluster down 85%. overall 429 rate back to baseline.

kiran: let's keep WAF rule and rate-limit for 2 hours then evaluate. If stable, relax anon rps to 1.0.

meera: logging note: capture example traces for forensics (IPs, payload hashes, API keys). saving to /incidents/4345012345/artifacts.

support-ledger: sent customer messages, included note about temporary throttle and ETA for re-evaluation.

sam: handing off live monitoring to kiran. I'll join if alarms trigger.

kiran: acknowledged. ping me in #pager if any regressions. I'll follow-up with a short post-incident summary once we close. :thumbsup:

pagerduty-bot: Incident acknowledged by kiran. escalation window 45m.

ashley: small post-mit note — we should add a short-term quota for new keys created in the last 24h. created task ENG-ops-392 to track.

meera: thanks all, looks stable. closing active mitigation after monitoring window unless we see recurrence.
